chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Lu's Cotton Club audition and Bill Robinson's anger
summary: Lu sang Don't You Feel My Leg at a Cotton Club audition and Bill Robinson raged that she sang it in front of his wife, costing her the job.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Danny took me down to the Cotton Club to make this audition, and I was singing the blues, and I sang "Don't You Feel My Leg," you know. And Bill Robinson's wife, oh, she was enjoyin' it! All of those chorus girls and everybody was enjoying what I was doing, you know. All of a sudden, here comes Bill Robinson talking about me singing that kind of stuff in front of his wife.
Right in the back. He wanted to fight me. I insulted his wife.

So then she got all (?) and quiet and lookin' all innocent. And she was the one enjoying it more than anybody else! But he comes in. And that stopped me from getting a job. But I can't hide(?) ...(?).
